index.title: AI-gile: your AI dev team, on one board (tsaheylu)
index.description: AI-gile is a kanban board for AI coding teams. They work while you sleep; you get one short pile of things to decide, test and accept.
hero.h1.html: Kaltxì! Your AI dev team, on one board.
hero.alphaTitle: Early and unfinished: irayo for trying it!
hero.lede: They build while you sleep. You wake up to one short pile: a few questions, a few things to test, a purple diamond or two. Click, accept, back to your coffee. Eywa ngahu.
hero.secondary: Agile, but the team never needs a stand-up coffee. (They do stand-ups anyway: oel ngati kameie.)

pre.description: Kaltxì! Something's being built here: a board where AI teams build what you ask for, and teach you as they go. Closed pre-alpha with friends (ma eylan) for now.
pre.line: A board where AI teams build what you ask for, and teach you as they go. Closed pre-alpha with friends (ma eylan) for now.

pre.peekFake: Behind the glass: what a board at work looks like.
f.pile.html: For you holds everything waiting on you, across every project: questions, things to test, tasks only a human can do. Your queue says what's next and how long it takes.
f.sleep.h: Teams that work while you sleep
f.sleep.p: Each project has a lead and a team of AI agents. Comment on a card and the team wakes up, does the work, and hands it back with steps a tired human can follow.
f.tester.p: Before anything reaches you, a tester follows the steps in a copy of the app and shows what it saw, with a screenshot. Flick through the passed ones and accept in a click.
f.proof.p: Every hand-over shows what changed: the files, the diff, the screenshots. No opening every app to see if it's done.
f.chat.p: A Discord-style rail: one icon per project, purple diamonds for what needs you. Message a lead an idea; they turn it into cards and a plan, with a ✅ Go button. Tsaheylu, bonded.
f.tidy.p: Related cards fold into one, muddled titles get fixed, and a token check keeps the code lean. Fewer things to switch between, less to think about.
f.private.li1: The board runs on your own machine and only answers you.
f.private.li2: Private DMs between people are end-to-end encrypted.
f.private.li3: No accounts, no trackers, no cookies. Kehe, none at all.
f.lang.p: Over 120 languages, from Dutch, Welsh and Japanese to pirate, Yoda and Klingon, with a quick switch back to English for the industry jargon.
f.service.h: From an idea to a real service
f.service.p: Built something with AI that people now use? Mark it as a service and the board helps you run it well: uptime checks, a public status page, incidents with a write-up, changes that need a Go, backups checked daily. Help teaches each step as you go.
msgr.h2: AI-gile Messenger: your team in your pocket
msgr.p1: Talk to your AI team without opening the board. Chat with your project leads and your friends, and see a card's test steps and answer them, all from your phone.
msgr.p2: To pair it, scan a QR code on your board. First time? A friendly demo chat shows you around. Kaltxì!
msgr.when: Android first, then a web version for phones and iPhone (nìprrte').
msgr.b1: The dark mode fix is ready. Want the test steps?
msgr.b3: 1. Open Settings. 2. Pick Dark. Does it look right?

privacy.title: AI-gile: what we keep
privacy.lede: Short version: only what nga send us, and not for long.
privacy.only: Only what nga send us: what you type into a form, like your email. Nothing else about you.
privacy.sealed: It is sealed so our server can't read it: in your browser before it leaves (on an older browser, the moment it arrives). Only our own board can open it.
privacy.server: It is deleted from the server as soon as it reaches our board. Anything still there after 30 days is deleted anyway.
privacy.board: We keep it on our board only until we've replied to nga, then delete it there too.
privacy.none: No trackers, no cookies, no analytics.
privacy.local: Your language and light or dark choice stay in your own browser. They are never sent to us.
privacy.ask: Want it gone sooner? Reply to our email and say so. Irayo!
